slides.text: BolBot: The AI Sales Assistant for Bharat's 63 Million MSMEs
Problem: Indian SMEs lose 65% of customer inquiries on WhatsApp due to slow manual response times.
Market: ₹500 crore market opportunity in India for automated WhatsApp commerce.
Competition: No direct competitors in our niche. Generic chatbots lack catalog checkout.
Product & Traction: Proprietary multilingual voice-to-cart engine. 180 paying merchants, 45 new additions monthly.
Unit Economics: ARPU ₹3,500/mo. CAC of ₹2,500 with rapid payback. Gross Margin 75%. Churn 4.5%.
Team: Ex-Swiggy and Ex-Zoho engineers with 12 years combined conversational AI experience.
The Ask: Raising ₹2.5 Cr at ₹15 Cr post-money valuation. 18 months runway (₹800000 initial fixed monthly burn).
